chemistry-e1-l1.title: Halaye daban-daban na abubuwa da kayan aiki · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-e1-l1.concept: Kayan da ake yin abu da su ana kiransu sinadari (material). Ƙarfe, roba, gilashi da roba mai laushi (rubber) kowanne yana da halaye na musamman.
chemistry-e1-l1.example: Ana yin taga da gilashi mai bayyanawa wanda haske yake ratsawa, kuma ana yin tayar mota da rubber wanda yake mikewa kuma yana da ƙarfi.

chemistry-e1-l2.title: Halaye daban-daban na abubuwa da kayan aiki · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-e1-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan halaye daban-daban na abubuwa da kayan aiki da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-e1-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-e2-l1.title: Abubuwan da ke narkewa a ruwa da cakuɗe-cakuɗe · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-e2-l1.concept: Idan wani abu ya haɗu daidai da ruwa har ba a ganinsa, ana cewa 'ya narke (dissolution)'. Abubuwan da ba sa narkewa suna nutsewa a ƙasa ko suna yawo.
chemistry-e2-l1.example: Gishiri yana narkewa a ruwa ya zama mai haske, amma yashi ba ya narkewa a ruwa, yana nutsewa a ƙasa.

chemistry-e2-l2.title: Abubuwan da ke narkewa a ruwa da cakuɗe-cakuɗe · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-e2-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan abubuwan da ke narkewa a ruwa da cakuɗe-cakuɗe da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-e2-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-e3-l1.title: Yanayi uku na abu: mai ƙarfi, ruwa da gas · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-e3-l1.concept: Mai ƙarfi yana da siffa da girma tsayayyu. Ruwa siffarsa tana canzawa bisa kwanon da yake ciki, amma girmansa tsayayye ne. Gas kuma siffa da girmansa duka suna canzawa cikin 'yanci.
chemistry-e3-l1.example: Kankara (mai ƙarfi), ruwa (ruwa) da tururi (gas) yanayi uku ne na ruwa.

chemistry-e3-l2.title: Yanayi uku na abu: mai ƙarfi, ruwa da gas · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-e3-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan yanayi uku na abu da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-e3-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-e4-l1.title: Ƙafewa, tafasa, condensation da canjin girman kankara · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-e4-l1.concept: Ruwa yana zama gas ana kiransa vaporization (ƙafewa, tafasa), gas yana zama ruwa ana kiransa liquefaction (condensation), mai ƙarfi yana zama ruwa kuma ana kiransa melting.
chemistry-e4-l1.example: Idan ruwa ya daskare a lokacin hunturu mai sanyi, girmansa yana ƙaruwa kuma gwangwanin abin sha ko kwalbar PET suna kumbura.

chemistry-e4-l2.title: Ƙafewa, tafasa, condensation da canjin girman kankara · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-e4-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan ƙafewa, tafasa, condensation da canjin girman kankara da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-e4-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-e5-l1.title: Solute, solvent, solution da concentration · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-e5-l1.concept: Abin da yake narkewa solute ne, ruwan da yake narkarwa solvent ne, kuma ruwan da aka haɗa daidai solution ne. A solution, ko da ka ɗauki wane yanki, ɗanɗano, launi da concentration iri ɗaya ne.
chemistry-e5-l1.example: Idan aka narkar da gishiri (solute) cikin ruwa (solvent), ana samun ruwan gishiri (solution).

chemistry-e5-l2.title: Solute, solvent, solution da concentration · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-e5-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan solute, solvent, solution da concentration da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-e5-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-e6-l1.title: Acidic, basic da abubuwa 3 na ƙonewa · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-e6-l1.concept: Acidic solution (vinegar, ruwan lemun tsami) yana mayar da shuɗin litmus paper ja, kuma basic solution (ruwan sabulu) yana mayar da jan paper shuɗi. Ƙonewa yana buƙatar abin da zai ƙone, oxygen da zafi sama da ignition point.
chemistry-e6-l1.example: Idan aka saka vinegar a indicator na jan kabeji yana zama ja, idan aka saka ruwan sabulu yana zama shuɗi/rawaya.

chemistry-e6-l2.title: Acidic, basic da abubuwa 3 na ƙonewa · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-e6-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan acidic, basic da abubuwa 3 na ƙonewa da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-e6-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-m1-l1.title: Dokar Boyle, Dokar Charles da canjin yanayi · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-m1-l1.concept: Idan zafi bai canza ba, girman gas yana da alaƙa mai juyawa da matsi (Dokar Boyle: $PV=\text{kullum}$). Idan matsi bai canza ba, girman gas yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da zafi (Dokar Charles).
chemistry-m1-l1.example: Idan aka saka ƙwallon table tennis da ta lalace a ruwa mai zafi, motsin ƙwayoyin gas yana ƙaruwa kuma ƙwallon tana miƙewa tauri.

chemistry-m1-l2.title: Dokar Boyle, Dokar Charles da canjin yanayi · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-m1-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan Dokar Boyle, Dokar Charles da canjin yanayi da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-m1-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-m2-l1.title: Element, atom, ion da reaction na samar da precipitate · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-m2-l1.concept: Element shi ne ainihin sinadarin da yake samar da abu. Idan atom ya rasa electrons yana zama cation, idan ya sami electrons yana zama anion. Idan wasu ions suka haɗu, suna samar da precipitate wanda ba ya narkewa a ruwa.
chemistry-m2-l1.example: Idan aka saka silver nitrate solution a sodium chloride solution, ana samar da farin silver chloride ($\text{AgCl}$) precipitate.

chemistry-m2-l2.title: Element, atom, ion da reaction na samar da precipitate · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-m2-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan element, atom, ion da reaction na samar da precipitate da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-m2-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-m3-l1.title: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-m3-l1.concept: Kafin da bayan chemical reaction, nau'i da adadin atoms ba sa canzawa, don haka jimillar mass tana kiyayewa. A cikin compound, rabon mass tsakanin elements ɗinsa tsayayye ne.
chemistry-m3-l1.example: Hydrogen $1\text{ g}$ da oxygen $8\text{ g}$ suna haɗuwa su samar da ruwa $9\text{ g}$ (rabon mass $1:8$).

chemistry-m3-l2.title: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-m3-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-m3-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-h1-l1.title: Ionic bond, covalent bond da oxidation-reduction · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-h1-l1.concept: Elements suna samar da ionic ko covalent bonds don cika octet rule (tsarin electron na rukuni na 18). Oxidation shi ne rasa electrons, reduction kuma shi ne samun electrons.
chemistry-h1-l1.example: Sodium chloride ($\text{NaCl}$) a matsayin mai ƙarfi ba ya ɗaukar lantarki, amma idan aka narkar da shi a ruwa ions suna motsawa kuma wutar lantarki tana gudana.

chemistry-h1-l2.title: Ionic bond, covalent bond da oxidation-reduction · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-h1-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan ionic bond, covalent bond da oxidation-reduction da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-h1-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-h2-l1.title: Mole (mol) da alaƙar adadi a cikin lissafin chemical reaction · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-h2-l1.concept: Ƙwayoyi $6.02 \times 10^{23}$ ana kiransu $1\text{ mol}$. Rabon coefficients na lissafin chemical reaction daidai yake da rabon mole, rabon adadin ƙwayoyi da rabon girman gas.
chemistry-h2-l1.example: Girman $1\text{ mol}$ na gas a $0^\circ\text{C}$ da $1\text{ atm}$ shi ne $22.4\text{ L}$.

chemistry-h2-l2.title: Mole (mol) da alaƙar adadi a cikin lissafin chemical reaction · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-h2-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan mole (mol) da alaƙar adadi a cikin lissafin chemical reaction da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-h2-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-h3-l1.title: Saurin reaction, ƙa'idar Le Chatelier da chemical cell · Binciken tushe da muhimmiyar ƙa'ida
chemistry-h3-l1.concept: Catalyst yana canza activation energy don daidaita sauri. Idan aka canza wani abu a dynamic equilibrium system, equilibrium yana komawa hanyar da take rage wannan canjin (ƙa'idar Le Chatelier).
chemistry-h3-l1.example: Lokacin synthesis na ammonia ta Haber-Bosch process, idan aka ƙara matsi, equilibrium yana komawa forward reaction wanda yake rage adadin ƙwayoyin gas.

chemistry-h3-l2.title: Saurin reaction, ƙa'idar Le Chatelier da chemical cell · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
chemistry-h3-l2.concept: Yana gina ikon fassara bayanan gwaji kan saurin reaction, ƙa'idar Le Chatelier da chemical cell da warware matsaloli ta amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum.
chemistry-h3-l2.example: Ku cimma matsayar bincike na kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanan adadi da nazarin kuskure.

chemistry-e1-q1.prompt: Daga cikin waɗannan, wane ne ya haɗa daidai 'abu' (wanda yake da takamaiman siffa da amfani) da 'kayan' da aka yi shi da su (wato 'sinadari')?

options.a: Kujera (abu) — itace (kayan)
options.b: Gilashi (abu) — kofi (kayan)
options.c: Ƙarfe (abu) — almakashi (kayan)
options.d: Roba (abu) — kwano (kayan)

hints: 'Abu' shi ne sunan kayan da aka gama yi da muke amfani da shi, 'kayan' kuwa sunan abin da aka yi shi da shi ne.
Kujera abu ce, itace kuwa kayan ƙerawa ne.
chemistry-e1-q1.explanation: Abin da yake da siffa da amfani ana kiransa 'abu', kuma ainihin kayan da aka yi abu da su ana kiransu 'kayan' (sinadari).

chemistry-e1-q2.prompt: Menene ainihin halayyar wani kayan da yake miƙewa idan an ja shi da ƙarfi, sannan ya koma siffarsa ta asali idan an sake shi, kamar zaren roba ko balan-balan?

options.a: Mikewa da komawa (elasticity)
options.b: Bayyanawa (transparency)
options.c: Maganaɗisu (magnetism)
options.d: Cin wuta (flammability)

hints: Halayya ce ta komawa siffar asali.
Ka tuna da ƙarfin mikewa da kake ji a zaren roba.
chemistry-e1-q2.explanation: Halayyar da abin da aka lalata siffarsa ta ƙarfi daga waje yake komawa siffarsa ta asali idan ƙarfin ya ƙare ana kiranta 'elasticity' (mikewa da komawa).

chemistry-e1-q3.prompt: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai halayen kayan da ake yin 'rigar ruwan sama' da 'gilashin ninkaya' da su?

options.a: Rigar ruwan sama: ba ta barin ruwa ya ratsa ta (hana ruwa) / gilashin ninkaya: bayyanawa don a gani sosai
options.b: Rigar ruwan sama: kyakkyawar ɗaukar wutar lantarki / gilashin ninkaya: karyewa cikin sauƙi
options.c: Rigar ruwan sama: cin wuta cikin sauƙi / gilashin ninkaya: nauyi
options.d: Rigar ruwan sama: shan ruwa sosai / gilashin ninkaya: rashin bayyanawa

hints: Kada ruwa ya shiga rigar ruwan sama; gilashin ninkaya kuma dole ne ya bar ka ka ga gaba sosai.
Ana tsara amfani bisa halayen kayan.
chemistry-e1-q3.explanation: Ana yin rigar ruwan sama da kayan da ba su ratsa ruwa (leda/roba) don kada ruwan sama ya jiƙa mutum, kuma ana yin gilashin ninkaya da roba ko gilashi mai bayyanawa don a ga abubuwa a cikin ruwa.

chemistry-e1-q4.prompt: Menene dalilin kimiyya na yin jikin kaskon suya ko tukunyar girki da ƙarfe, amma hannun riƙonsu da roba ko itace?

options.a: Saboda ƙarfe yana ɗaukar zafi da sauri, roba da itace kuma ba sa ɗaukar zafi sosai, don haka hannu ba ya ƙonewa
options.b: Saboda hannun ƙarfe yana da sauƙi sosai
options.c: Saboda roba tana canza ɗanɗanon abinci zuwa mai kyau
options.d: Domin a huda jikin tukunyar

hints: Don a dafa abinci, zafi yana buƙatar ya isa ƙasan tukunyar da sauri.
Ba za a iya riƙe hannu idan ya yi zafi ba.
chemistry-e1-q4.explanation: Ƙarfe yana da babbar ƙarfin ɗaukar zafi, don haka ana iya dafa abinci da sauri; roba da itace kuma suna hana zafi wucewa sosai, don haka ana iya riƙe hannun yayin girki ba tare da ƙonewa ba.

chemistry-e1-c.prompt: [Binciken muhalli mai zurfi] Roba tana da fa'idodin sauƙi, ƙarfi da rashin ruɓewa, amma idan aka jefar da ita ba ta ruɓewa a yanayi tsawon ɗaruruwan shekaru, kuma tana gurɓata muhalli. Wace hanyar ci gaban kimiyyar kayan aiki ce daidai don magance wannan?

options.a: Ƙera 'robar da take ruɓewa ta halitta' daga sitacin masara da makamantansu, wadda ƙananan halittu suke ruɓar da ita
options.b: Jefa dukkan roba a teku don ta nutse
options.c: Binne roba a ƙarƙashin ƙasa mai zurfi a manta da ita
options.d: Mayar da dukkan kayan gida na amfani sau ɗaya kawai

hints: Sabon kayan ne mai abokantaka da muhalli, wanda ƙananan halittu za su iya ci su ruɓar da shi.
Fasahar ruɓewa ta halitta ce (Biodegradable).
chemistry-e1-c.explanation: Don rage gurɓata muhalli, ana ƙera robar halitta (bioplastic) daga kayan shuka wadda ƙananan halittu ke ruɓar da ita zuwa ruwa da carbon dioxide bayan wani lokaci.

chemistry-e1-q5.prompt: Ƙusa ko almakashi da aka yi da ƙarfe yana yin tsatsa mai jan launi idan an bar shi cikin ruwa da iska tsawon lokaci. Wace hanya ce daidai ta kimiyyar kayan aiki don hana wannan?

options.a: A shafa mai a sirari ko a yi fenti don a hana saduwar iska da danshi
options.b: A jiƙa shi cikin ruwa don a fitar da iska
options.c: A wanke ƙarfen da ruwan gishiri kowace rana
options.d: A busar da shi sosai a rana a ajiye shi da zafi ƙwarai

hints: Don ƙarfe ya yi tsatsa (oxidation), yana buƙatar duka iskar oxygen da danshi.
Idan aka rufe fuskar, za a iya toshe oxygen da ruwa.
chemistry-e1-q5.explanation: Tsatsar ƙarfe tana faruwa ne ta hanyar mu'amalar oxygen da danshi, don haka idan aka shafa mai, aka yi fenti, ko aka yi plating a saman, ta yadda iska da ruwa ba za su taɓa shi ba, ƙarfen ba zai yi tsatsa ba.

chemistry-e2-q1.prompt: Idan aka zuba cokali ɗaya na sukari cikin kofin ruwa mai ɗumi aka juya da sandar gilashi, wane bayani ne daidai game da abin da ke faruwa?

options.a: Ƙwayoyin sukari suna rabuwa zuwa ƙanana sosai, suna yaɗuwa cikin dukkan ruwan, kuma ba a ganinsu
options.b: Sukarin yana tauri a ƙasan kofin kamar dutse
options.c: Sukarin yana hawa saman ruwa ya tashi gaba ɗaya cikin iska
options.d: Ruwan da ke cikin kofin yana zama baƙi

hints: Ka kiyaye abin da ake kira narkewa (dissolution).
Ruwan yana zama mai haske, amma idan ka ɗanɗana har yanzu yana da zaƙi.
chemistry-e2-q1.explanation: Idan sukari ya narke cikin ruwa, ƙwayoyin sukari suna warwatsewa daidai tsakanin ƙwayoyin ruwa, ba a ganinsu, kuma suna samar da ruwan sukari mai haske.

chemistry-e2-q2.prompt: Menene dalilin da sukari yake narkewa da sauri sosai a kofin ruwa mai ɗumi fiye da kofin ruwan sanyi?

options.a: Saboda idan zafin ya ƙaru, motsin ƙwayoyin ruwa yana ƙaruwa, kuma suna kwashe ƙwayoyin sukari da sauri
options.b: Saboda ruwa mai ɗumi yana sanyaya sukari
options.c: Saboda ruwa mai ɗumi yana ɗauke da iska da yawa
options.d: Saboda ruwan sanyi yana korar sukari

hints: Idan zafin ya ƙaru, motsin ƙwayoyin yana yin sauri.
Ka yi tunanin lokacin da kake saka kubin sukari a kofin shayi ka juya.
chemistry-e2-q2.explanation: Idan zafin ruwa ya ƙaru, motsin zafi na ƙwayoyin ruwa yana ƙaruwa kuma suna yin karo da ƙwayoyin sukari akai-akai da ƙarfi, don haka saurin narkewa yana ƙaruwa.

chemistry-e2-q3.prompt: Idan aka zuba ruwan gishiri da ruwan laka kowanne a cikin mazurari mai takardar tacewa, wane ne ya haɗa daidai abin da ya rage a saman takardar tacewa?

options.a: Ruwan gishiri: babu abin da ya rage / ruwan laka: ƙwayoyin laka sun tace a saman takarda
options.b: Ruwan gishiri: dunƙulen gishiri ya rage / ruwan laka: babu abin da ya rage
options.c: Ruwan gishiri da ruwan laka duka suna ratsa takardar tacewa kamar yadda suke
options.d: Ruwan gishiri da ruwan laka duka suna ragewa a saman takardar tacewa

hints: Ƙwayoyin da suka narke gaba ɗaya a cikin ruwa sun fi ramukan takardar tacewa ƙanƙanta sosai.
Ƙwayoyin laka da ba su narke ba suna tacewa a takardar.
chemistry-e2-q3.explanation: Gishiri ya narke gaba ɗaya, ƙwayoyinsa sun fi ramukan takardar tacewa ƙanƙanta, don haka suna ratsawa; amma ƙwayoyin laka ba su narke ba, don haka ba sa iya ratsa ramukan takardar, sai su rage.

chemistry-e2-q4.prompt: Wace hanyar canjin yanayin abu da raba kayan haɗin ce ake amfani da ita a gonar gishiri don samun tsabtataccen gishirin da muke ci daga ruwan teku?

options.a: A bar ruwan ya ƙafe da hasken rana da iska, sai lu'ulu'an gishiri kawai su rage
options.b: A dafa ruwan teku sosai ya zama kankara
options.c: A saka maganaɗisu cikin ruwan teku ya jawo gishiri
options.d: A tace da raga a fitar da gishiri kawai daga ruwan teku

hints: Idan ruwan teku da aka shimfiɗa a sirari a gonar gishiri ya sami rana, ruwan ne kawai yake zama tururi ya tashi.
Hanyar raba haɗin abubuwa ce ta amfani da ƙafewa.
chemistry-e2-q4.explanation: Idan aka tara ruwan teku a gonar gishiri aka bar hasken rana da iska su ƙafar da ruwan, ruwan ne kawai yake zama tururin iska ya tashi, sai lu'ulu'an gishiri da aka narkar su rage fari.

chemistry-e2-c.prompt: [Binciken ƙa'ida mai zurfi] Akwai ruwan gishiri da aka yi ta narkar da gishiri g 10 gaba ɗaya a cikin ruwa g 100. Idan aka auna nauyin dukkan wannan ruwan gishiri da ma'aunin lantarki, zai zama g nawa?
hints: Ko da gishiri ya narke ba a gani, bai ɓace ba.
Kiyayewar nauyi: (nauyin ruwa) + (nauyin gishiri) = ?
chemistry-e2-c.explanation: Idan abu ya narke, ƙwayoyin abin da aka narkar (gishiri) suna warwatsewa tsakanin ƙwayoyin ruwa kawai, ba sa ɓacewa; don haka nauyin dukkan maganar yana kiyayewa daidai a g 110, wato jimillar nauyin ruwa da gishiri.

chemistry-e2-q5.prompt: Menene dalilin da ruwa da man girki, ko da an saka su a kwalba ɗaya aka girgiza da ƙarfi, suke sake rabuwa gaba ɗaya zuwa yadudduka biyu idan aka bar su na ɗan lokaci?

options.a: Saboda man girki ba ya haɗuwa da ruwa kuma yawansa ya yi ƙasa da na ruwa, don haka yana yawo a sama
options.b: Saboda man girki yana shan ruwa
options.c: Saboda ruwa ya fi man girki ɗumi
options.d: Saboda man girki ya taurara ya zama ƙarfi

hints: Ruwa yana da polarity, mai kuma ba shi da polarity, don haka ba sa narkar da juna.
Mai ya fi ruwa sauƙi (yawansa ya ragu) don haka yana yawo a sama.
chemistry-e2-q5.explanation: Ruwa ƙwayar polar ne kuma man girki ƙwayar non-polar ne, don haka ba sa haɗuwa; yawan man girki (kusan 0.92 g/cm³) ya yi ƙasa da na ruwa (1.0 g/cm³), don haka yana yawo a babban Layer.

chemistry-e3-q1.prompt: Wane yanayin abu ne yake canza siffarsa cikin 'yanci bisa kwanon da aka saka shi, amma girmansa (volume) ba ya canzawa yana tsayawa daidai?

options.a: Ruwa (liquid)
options.b: Mai ƙarfi (solid)
options.c: Gas
options.d: Plasma

hints: Ka yi tunanin lokacin da kake zuba ruwa ko madara a wani kofi.
Siffa tana bin kofin, amma adadin (girma) iri ɗaya ne.
chemistry-e3-q1.explanation: Ruwa yana da haɗin ƙwayoyi mafi sassauƙa fiye da mai ƙarfi, don haka siffarsa tana canzawa cikin sauƙi bisa kwanon da yake ciki, amma tun da jan hankalin ƙwayoyi yana nan, girmansa yana tsayawa daidai.

chemistry-e3-q2.prompt: An cika sirinji ɗaya da ruwa, wani kuma da iska, sannan aka toshe bakin sirinji da yatsa aka tura piston da ƙarfi. Me zai faru?

options.a: Piston ɗin sirinjin iska zai shiga sosai, amma na sirinjin ruwa kusan ba zai shiga ba
options.b: Sirinjin ruwa zai shiga fiye da na iska da yawa
options.c: Sirinji biyu duka za su shiga gaba ɗaya har ƙarshe
options.d: Sirinji biyu duka ba za su motsa ko kaɗan ba

hints: Ƙwayoyin gas suna da nisa sosai da juna, don haka akwai sarari mai yawa.
Gas yana matsewa cikin sauƙi, amma ruwa yana da wuyar matsawa sosai.
chemistry-e3-q2.explanation: Gas (iska) yana da nisa sosai tsakanin ƙwayoyinsa, don haka yana matsewa cikin sauƙi idan an yi masa matsi kuma girmansa yana raguwa; ruwa kuwa ƙwayoyinsa sun riga sun haɗu sosai, don haka kusan ba ya matsewa.

chemistry-e3-q3.prompt: Wane ne daidai game da ɗabi'ar da ta zama gama-gari ga abubuwan 'mai ƙarfi' da muke gani a kusa da mu?

options.a: Siffa da girma suna tsayawa daidai ko da an canza kwanon da aka saka su
options.b: Siffa tana canzawa cikin 'yanci bisa kwanon da aka saka su
options.c: Ba za a iya riƙe su da hannu ba kuma ba a ganinsu kwata-kwata
options.d: Suna cika sarari gaba ɗaya suna yaɗuwa ba tare da ƙarewa ba

hints: Ka tuna lokacin da kake canja wurin gutsin itace ko dutse zuwa wata akwati.
Siffarsu ba ta canzawa.
chemistry-e3-q3.explanation: A cikin mai ƙarfi, ƙwayoyin da suke samar da abin suna haɗe da juna sosai a tsari, don haka siffa da girma suna tsayawa daidai, sai dai in an yi musu ƙarfi daga waje.

chemistry-e3-q4.prompt: Bayan an buɗe murfin kwalbar turare a kusurwar ɗaki, bayan ɗan lokaci ƙamshin turaren ya isa hancin mutumin da yake gefen ɗakin na can. Wace ƙa'idar kimiyya ce ke bayyana wannan al'amari?

options.a: Al'amarin 'yaɗuwa (diffusion)', inda ƙwayoyin gas ɗin turare suke motsawa da kansu suna yaɗuwa cikin iska
options.b: Saboda ruwan turare ya daskare ya mirgina a ƙasa
options.c: Saboda ƙwayoyin turare sun jawo hanci kamar maganaɗisu
options.d: Saboda iska ta cinye ƙamshin turare

hints: Ƙwayoyin da suke samar da abubuwa ba sa tsayawa; suna motsawa kullum da kansu.
Menene ake kira al'amarin yaɗuwar gas?
chemistry-e3-q4.explanation: Al'amarin da ƙwayoyin turare suke motsawa kullum da kansu a kowace hanya cikin iska, suna yaɗuwa daga wuri mai yawan tattarawa zuwa wuri mai ƙarancin tattarawa ana kiransa 'yaɗuwa (diffusion)'.

chemistry-e3-c.prompt: [Gwajin tunani mai zurfi] Shin iskar da ba a gani ma tana da nauyi (mass) kamar mai ƙarfi ko ruwa? Wace hanyar gwaji ce mafi dacewa don tabbatar da hakan?

options.a: A auna ƙwallon kwando da aka cika da iska da ma'aunin lantarki mai daidaito, sannan a fitar da iskar a sake aunawa don a ga bambancin nauyi
options.b: A jefa balan-balan sama a kiyaye yadda yake tashi
options.c: A bar kwalbar gilashi mara komai a rana don a ga ko tana ɗumama
options.d: A saka hannu cikin ruwa a auna yadda ruwan yake sanyi

hints: Gas ma abu ne, don haka yana da mass.
Kwatanta karatun ma'auni lokacin da aka saka iska da lokacin da aka cire ta.
chemistry-e3-c.explanation: Idan aka auna ƙwallon da aka cika da iska, sannan aka fitar da iskar aka sake aunawa, ana ganin nauyin yana raguwa, wanda ke tabbatar da cewa iska, wacce gas ce, ma tana da mass da nauyi.

chemistry-e3-q5.prompt: Idan aka bar 'dry ice' mai sanyi da ake saka a cikin kunshin ice cream a zafin ɗaki, babu ɗigon ruwa da yake bayyana kwata-kwata, kai tsaye yana zama gas ya tashi ya ɓace. Wane canjin yanayi ne wannan?

options.a: 'Sublimation' – mai ƙarfi yana zama gas kai tsaye ba tare da wucewa ta ruwa ba
options.b: 'Melting' – mai ƙarfi yana narkewa zuwa ruwa
options.c: 'Vaporization' – ruwa yana tafasa zuwa gas
options.d: 'Liquefaction' – gas yana zama ruwa

hints: Dry ice carbon dioxide ne mai ƙarfi.
A zafin ɗaki da matsi 1 atm, yana sublimation kai tsaye zuwa gas ba tare da wucewa ta ruwa ba.
chemistry-e3-q5.explanation: Dry ice (carbon dioxide mai ƙarfi) ba ya iya wanzuwa a matsayin ruwa a matsi na yau da kullum (1 atm), kuma yana canzawa kai tsaye daga mai ƙarfi zuwa gas, abin da ake kira 'sublimation'.

chemistry-e4-q1.prompt: Bayan an ɗauko gwangwanin abin sha mai sanyi daga firiji aka bar shi a kan teburi na ɗan lokaci, ɗigon ruwa ya bayyana a saman gwangwanin. Daga ina wannan ɗigon ruwa ya fito?

options.a: Tururin ruwa na iska, wanda gas ne, ya taɓa gwangwanin mai sanyi ya zama ruwa ta condensation
options.b: Abin sha ya malalo waje ta bangon aluminium na gwangwanin
options.c: Ɗigon ruwa ne daga fentin da ya narke a saman gwangwanin
options.d: Ruwan itace ne da ya fito daga katakon teburin

hints: Akwai tururin ruwa da ba a gani koyaushe a cikin iska.
Idan tururin ruwa ya haɗu da wuri mai sanyi, yana sanyi ya zama ɗigon ruwa (condensation).
chemistry-e4-q1.explanation: Tururin ruwa na iska yana haɗuwa da saman gwangwanin mai sanyi, ya rasa zafi, ya zama ɗigon ruwa; wannan al'amari ne na 'condensation' (liquefaction).

chemistry-e4-q2.prompt: Idan ruwa ya daskare ya zama kankara mai ƙarfi, wane ne daidai bayanin canjin nauyi da girma?

options.a: Nauyi ba ya canzawa, amma girma yana ƙaruwa
options.b: Nauyi da girma duka suna raguwa
options.c: Nauyi yana ƙaruwa amma girma yana raguwa
options.d: Nauyi da girma duka suna ƙaruwa

hints: Ko da ruwa ya daskare, jimillar ƙwayoyin da suke samar da abu ba ta canzawa.
Idan kankara ta yi, tana samar da tsarin zobe mai kusurwa shida kuma sarari mara komai yana ƙaruwa.
chemistry-e4-q2.explanation: Idan ruwa ya daskare ya zama kankara, mass (nauyi) yana kiyayewa, amma girma yana ƙaruwa da kusan 10% saboda ƙwayoyin ruwa suna samar da lu'ulu'u mai kusurwa shida mai sarari mara komai da yawa ta hanyar hydrogen bonds.

chemistry-e4-q3.prompt: Menene ainihin dalilin kimiyya na 'fashewar bututun ruwa' da yake faruwa idan bututun ruwa na waje ya daskare ya fashe saboda tsananin sanyi na hunturu?

options.a: Saboda ruwan da ke cikin bututu yana faɗaɗa lokacin da ya daskare, yana tura bangon bututu da ƙarfi
options.b: Saboda bututun ƙarfe yana ƙuntatawa saboda sanyi ya narke
options.c: Saboda matsin ruwa yana ƙaruwa ba zato ba tsammani sau 10 a hunturu
options.d: Saboda kankara tana samar da wutar lantarki ta ƙone bututu

hints: Ka yi tunanin yadda girma yake canzawa idan ruwa ya zama kankara.
Idan ruwa ya daskare, girmansa yana ƙaruwa.
chemistry-e4-q3.explanation: Ruwa yana da keɓantaccen ɗabi'a na faɗaɗa idan ya daskare; don haka idan ruwan da ya cika bututu ya daskare, matsi na faɗaɗawa yana lalata bututun ƙarfe mai ƙarfi, wanda shi ne fashewar bututu.

chemistry-e4-q4.prompt: Wane ne daidai bayanin bambancin tsakanin 'evaporation' da 'boiling' idan ana zafafa ruwa a tukunya?

options.a: Evaporation yana faruwa a saman ruwa kawai, boiling kuwa yana faruwa a wurin tafasa (100℃) tare da kumfa a saman da cikin ruwa gaba ɗaya
options.b: Evaporation yana faruwa a 100℃ kawai, boiling kuwa yana faruwa a kowane zafi
options.c: Evaporation shi ne ruwa ya zama kankara, boiling kuwa shi ne ya zama tururi
options.d: Evaporation da boiling al'amari ɗaya ne gaba ɗaya

hints: Bushewar kayan wanki evaporation ne da yake faruwa a hankali a saman ko da a ƙarancin zafi.
Tafasar ruwa sosai a 100 digiri boiling ne, inda kumfa ke fashewa daga ciki ma.
chemistry-e4-q4.explanation: Evaporation al'amari ne da ƙwayoyin saman ruwa suke zama gas ko da a ƙasa da wurin tafasa; boiling kuwa al'amari ne da ruwa ya kai wurin tafasa kuma yake zama gas sosai ba a saman kawai ba har ma a cikinsa gaba ɗaya.

chemistry-e4-c.prompt: [Canjin yanayi mai zurfi] An saka ruwa a cikin beaker aka zafafa shi har ya fara tafasa sosai. Ko da an ƙara ƙarfin wutar ana ci gaba da zafafawa, karatun thermometer ba ya sake tashi sama da 100℃. Menene dalili?

options.a: Saboda zafin da ake bayarwa ba ya ƙara zafin ruwa, sai dai ana amfani da shi gaba ɗaya wajen canjin yanayin ruwa zuwa tururi (heat of vaporization)
options.b: Saboda thermometer yana lalacewa sama da digiri 100
options.c: Saboda ruwa ba zai iya ɗaukar zafi ba kuma
options.d: Saboda tururi yana sanyaya thermometer

hints: Yayin da yanayi yake canzawa, zafin abu yana tsayawa daidai.
Ana kiran wannan 'latent heat' (heat of vaporization).
chemistry-e4-c.explanation: Idan tsattsauran ruwa yana tafasa, zafin da ake bayarwa gaba ɗaya yana ɗauka wajen karya jan hankalin ƙwayoyi da canzawa zuwa gas (heat of vaporization); don haka zafi yana tsayawa daidai har sai dukkan ruwan ya zama tururi.

chemistry-e4-q5.prompt: Wane ne ya haɗa daidai tsarin canjin yanayi na 'raɓa' mai tsabta da ke manne a ganyen ciyawa da safe da 'dusar ƙanƙara/sanyi (frost)' fari da ke kan tagogi ko rufi a daren ƙarshen kaka?

options.a: Raɓa: tururi yana zama ɗigon ruwa (liquefaction) / frost: tururi yana zama lu'ulu'un kankara kai tsaye (sublimation)
options.b: Raɓa: kankara tana narkewa (melting) / frost: ruwa yana tafasa (vaporization)
options.c: Raɓa da frost duka ruwa ne da ya ƙafe zuwa tururi
options.d: Raɓa: ruwan ɗimbin da ya fito daga ƙasa / frost: dusar ƙanƙara da ta sauko daga sama

hints: Raɓa ɗigon ruwa ne (tururi → ruwa).
Frost lu'ulu'un kankara ne da suka samu a zafin ƙasa da sifili (tururi → mai ƙarfi).
chemistry-e4-q5.explanation: Raɓa tana faruwa ne lokacin da tururin iska ya yi condensation a saman ganyen ciyawa da ya yi sanyi cikin dare; frost kuwa shi ne tururi yana zama lu'ulu'un kankara kai tsaye ba tare da wucewa ta ruwa ba a zafin ƙasa da sifili (sublimation na daskarewa).

chemistry-e5-q1.prompt: An narkar da sukari g 50 gaba ɗaya a cikin ruwa g 200. A cikin wannan ruwan sukari, wane ne ya haɗa daidai 'solvent', 'solute' da 'solution'?

options.a: Solvent: ruwa / solute: sukari / solution: ruwan sukari
options.b: Solvent: sukari / solute: ruwa / solution: ruwan sukari
options.c: Solvent: ruwan sukari / solute: sukari / solution: ruwa
options.d: Solvent: ruwa / solute: ruwan sukari / solution: sukari

hints: Ruwan da yake narkarwa = solvent, abin da yake narkewa = solute, cakuɗar da ta ƙare = solution.
A ruwan sukari, sukarin da yake narkewa solute ne, ruwan da yake narkarwa solvent ne.
chemistry-e5-q1.explanation: Ruwa, wanda yake narkarwa, ana kiransa 'solvent'; sukarin da yake narkewa 'solute'; cakuɗar da suka haɗu daidai suka zama bayyananne kuma ana kiranta 'solution'.

chemistry-e5-q2.prompt: Ana son bincika halayen ruwan gishiri a cikin beaker. Wane bayani ne daidai game da halayen solution, wanda cakuɗa ce mai daidaito?

options.a: Ko da ka ɗauki ɗanɗano daga sama, tsakiya ko ƙasan solution, matakin gishiri (concentration) iri ɗaya ne daidai
options.b: Bayan lokaci gishirin yana nauyi kuma yana nutsewa a ƙasa da kansa
options.c: Idan aka duba da gilashin ƙara girma, ana ganin ƙwayoyin gishiri suna yawo a cikin ruwa
options.d: Idan aka tace da takardar tacewa, dukkan gishirin yana tacewa a saman takardar

hints: Solution 'cakuɗa mai daidaito (homogeneous)' ce inda ƙwayoyin suke haɗe daidai matakin ƙwayar guda.
Ba ya nutsewa duk tsawon lokacin da aka bar shi.
chemistry-e5-q2.explanation: Solution na gaskiya (cakuɗa mai daidaito) ƙwayoyin solute suna warwatse daidai tsakanin ƙwayoyin solvent, don haka ba sa nutsewa ko da an bar su na dogon lokaci, kuma concentration iri ɗaya ne a kowane wuri.

chemistry-e5-q3.prompt: Idan ana saka gishiri a ruwa g 100, menene dalilin da gishiri yake narkewa fiye da haka lokacin da zafin ruwa yake 60℃ fiye da lokacin da yake 20℃?

options.a: Saboda idan zafi ya ƙaru, motsin zafi na ƙwayoyin solvent yana ƙaruwa kuma solubility (ikon ɗaukar solute) yana ƙaruwa
options.b: Saboda idan zafi ya yi yawa, tsarin ƙwayar gishiri yana lalacewa
options.c: Saboda ruwa mai ɗumi yana sa gishiri ya ƙafe
options.d: Saboda gishiri yana son ruwan sanyi

hints: Ka tuna da lanƙwasar canjin solubility bisa zafi.
Idan abu ya yi ɗumi, motsin ƙwayoyinsa yana ƙaruwa.
chemistry-e5-q3.explanation: Ga mafi yawan solids, idan zafi ya ƙaru, motsin ƙwayoyin solvent yana ƙaruwa kuma bisa yanayin enthalpy na narkewa, solubility (mafi yawan abin da za a iya narkarwa a cikin takamaiman adadin solvent) yana ƙaruwa.

chemistry-e5-q4.prompt: An saka tumatir ƙarami a tankin ruwa mai tsabta kuma ya nutse a ƙasa. Bayan an zuba gishiri mai yawa a tankin aka juya, tumatirin ya tashi yana yawo a saman ruwa. Menene dalili?

options.a: Saboda gishiri ya narke kuma yawan (density) ruwan gishirin ya fi na tumatir
options.b: Saboda gishiri ya ci tumatirin ya ɗauke masa nauyi
options.c: Saboda tumatirin ya yi sanyi ya fitar da iska
options.d: Saboda ruwan gishiri ya yi lantarki

hints: Idan yawan ruwa ya fi na abu, abun yana tashi sama.
Idan gishiri mai yawa ya narke, nauyin (density) ruwa yana ƙaruwa.
chemistry-e5-q4.explanation: Yawan ruwan gishiri ya fi na ruwa tsantsa; idan aka ci gaba da narkar da gishiri har yawan ruwan gishirin ya fi matsakaicin yawan tumatirin, ƙarfin tashi (buoyancy) ya fi nauyin jan ƙasa kuma tumatirin yana tashi sama.

chemistry-e5-c.prompt: [Crystallization mai zurfi] An yi saturated solution ta hanyar narkar da alum a ruwa mai ɗumi 60℃ har sai ya daina narkewa, sannan aka ɗaura zaren siliki a cikin maganar aka bar ta ta yi sanyi a hankali a zafin ɗaki, sai kyawawan lu'ulu'un alum masu haske kamar duwatsu masu daraja suka girma a zaren. Menene ƙa'idar wannan al'amari?

options.a: Saboda idan zafi ya ragu, solubility na alum yana raguwa, kuma abin da bai iya zama narkakke ba yana fitowa a matsayin lu'ulu'u mai ƙarfi
options.b: Saboda maganar alum ta daskare ta zama kankara
options.c: Saboda zaren siliki ya haɗa alum ta hanyar sinadarai
options.d: Saboda ƙurar iska ta koma alum

hints: Me zai faru idan mai ƙarfi da ya narke da yawa a lokacin ɗumi ya yi sanyi?
Idan zafi ya ragu kuma solubility ya yi ƙasa, yana fitowa waje (precipitation).
chemistry-e5-c.explanation: Idan zafi ya ragu, solubility na solid yana raguwa sosai; don haka solute da ya fi solubility ɗin da ya yi ƙasa (supersaturated) yana haɗuwa ya samar da lu'ulu'u na tsari yana fita, wanda shi ne al'amarin 'recrystallization (precipitation)'.

chemistry-e5-q5.prompt: Menene ƙa'idar kimiyya da take sa kumfa ya tashi sosai daga cikin abin sha tare da sautin 'tss' lokacin da aka buɗe murfin gwangwanin abin sha mai sanyi mai kumfa (sprite, cola)?

options.a: Idan aka buɗe gwangwani, matsin ciki yana sauka zuwa matsin yanayi, kuma solubility na gas ɗin carbon dioxide yana raguwa sosai
options.b: Idan aka buɗe gwangwani, zafin abin sha yana sauka ba zato ba tsammani zuwa ƙasa da sifili
options.c: Ruwan da ke cikin abin sha yana ƙafewa nan take
options.d: Iskar oxygen daga iska tana shiga cikin abin sha

hints: Ka yi tunanin Dokar Henry (Henry's law).
Solubility na gas yana ƙaruwa idan matsi ya yi yawa, yana raguwa idan matsi ya ragu.
chemistry-e5-q5.explanation: Carbon dioxide da ya narke da yawa a ruwa saboda matsi mai yawa a cikin gwangwani da aka rufe, idan aka buɗe murfin kuma matsi ya ragu, bisa Dokar Henry solubility yana raguwa kuma yana fita a matsayin kumfa.

chemistry-e6-q1.prompt: Bayan an digo wasu solutions a kan indicator na jan kabeji, solution A ya zama ja, solution B kuma ya zama shuɗi sannan rawaya. Wane ne daidai game da halayen solutions biyun?

options.a: Solution A acidic ne, solution B basic ne
options.b: Solution A basic ne, solution B acidic ne
options.c: Solution A da B duka neutral ne
options.d: Solution A neutral ne, solution B acidic ne

hints: Ruwan jan kabeji, indicator na halitta, yana ɗauke da launin anthocyanin.
A acid yana canzawa zuwa launuka masu ja, a base kuma zuwa shuɗi~rawaya.
chemistry-e6-q1.explanation: Indicator na jan kabeji yana zama ja a acidic solution, kuma a basic solution yana zama shuɗi, kore ko rawaya.

chemistry-e6-q2.prompt: Idan aka digo dilute hydrochloric acid ko vinegar a kan ƙwan kwai ko guntun marmara (mai sinadarin calcium carbonate), kumfa yana fitowa. Menene zai faru idan aka tara gas ɗin aka ratsa shi ta cikin lime water?

options.a: Lime water zai yi gizagizai fari (tabbatar da gas ɗin carbon dioxide)
options.b: Idan aka kawo wuta ga lime water, zai ƙone da sautin 'pop'
options.c: Launin lime water zai zama shuɗi
options.d: Babu wani canji da zai faru

hints: Idan carbonate ya yi reaction da acid, ana samar da gas ɗin carbon dioxide (CO₂).
Idan aka ratsa carbon dioxide ta lime water, ana samar da precipitate na calcium carbonate da ke sa shi ya yi gizagizai.
chemistry-e6-q2.explanation: Idan calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) ya yi reaction da acid, ana samar da gas ɗin carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$), kuma carbon dioxide yana yin reaction da lime water ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) ya samar da precipitate fari na calcium carbonate, wanda ke sa shi ya yi gizagizai.

chemistry-e6-q3.prompt: Menene ƙa'idar kimiyya ta hikimar rayuwar yau da kullum ta yayyafa ruwan lemun tsami ko vinegar don kawar da wari na kifi (trimethylamine mai halin basic, da sauransu) a lokacin dafa kifi?

options.a: Saboda acidic substance (ruwan lemun tsami) yana haɗuwa da basic fishy substance ya haifar da neutralization reaction
options.b: Saboda ruwan lemun tsami yana daskarar da naman kifi
options.c: Saboda vinegar yana narkar da calcium na ƙashin kifi
options.d: Saboda launin rawaya na lemun tsami yana rufe wari

hints: Idan acid da base sun haɗu, 'neutralization reaction' yana faruwa inda suke rasa halayensu.
Abubuwan wari na kifi basic ne.
chemistry-e6-q3.explanation: Amines, abubuwan da ke haifar da warin kifi, basic ne; don haka idan aka yayyafa acidic substance kamar ruwan lemun tsami (citric acid) ko vinegar (acetic acid), acid-base neutralization reaction yana faruwa kuma warin ya ɓace.

chemistry-e6-q4.prompt: A sansanin zango, bayan an kunna wutar sansani, rufe wutar da ƙasa ko yashi ko fesa na'urar kashe wuta hanya ce ta kashe wuta da take toshe wane ne daga cikin 'abubuwa 3 na ƙonewa'?

options.a: Toshe isar oxygen daga iska (kashewa ta shaƙewa)
options.b: Cire abin da zai ƙone (itace) gaba ɗaya
options.c: Ƙara zafi sama da ignition point
options.d: Shan carbon dioxide da ke kewaye

hints: Abubuwa 3 na ƙonewa: abin da zai ƙone, oxygen, zafi sama da ignition point
Idan aka rufe da yashi, iska ba ta isa wutar.
chemistry-e6-q4.explanation: Rufe wuta da yashi ko kauri mai kauri ko fesa na'urar kashe wuta ta carbon dioxide hanya ce ta 'kashewa ta shaƙewa' wadda take kashe wuta ta hanyar toshe shigowar oxygen gaba ɗaya.

chemistry-e6-c.prompt: [Zaton reaction mai zurfi] An haɗa dilute hydrochloric acid da sodium hydroxide solution (wanda yake mayar da jan litmus paper zuwa shuɗi) ta hanyar digo shi a hankali da dropper. Idan aka saka isasshen hydrochloric acid, wane ne daidai game da canjin da ke faruwa a cikin cakuɗar solution?

options.a: Ana samar da zafi, zafin ya tashi, kuma solution na ƙarshe yana mayar da shuɗin litmus paper zuwa ja
options.b: Solution yana yin sanyi sosai ya zama kankara
options.c: Babu wani reaction da ke faruwa kuma yana ci gaba da zama yadda yake
options.d: Gas ɗin hydrogen kawai ne yake fitowa da fashewa

hints: A neutralization reaction ana samar da zafin neutralization kuma zafi yana ƙaruwa.
Idan hydrochloric acid ya yi yawa, solution yana zama acidic.
chemistry-e6-c.explanation: Idan acid (hydrochloric acid) da base (sodium hydroxide) suka yi reaction, ana samar da ruwa da gishiri kuma ana fitar da zafin neutralization wanda ke sa zafi ya tashi. Idan aka ƙara hydrochloric acid fiye da kima, dukkan solution yana zama acidic ya mayar da shuɗin litmus paper zuwa ja.

chemistry-e6-q5.prompt: Idan wutar daji mai girma tana yaɗuwa, yin 'firebreak' ta hanyar sare bishiyoyi masu faɗi a gaban hanyar wutar da injin sare itace tun da wuri yana cire wane ne daga cikin abubuwa 3 na ƙonewa?

options.a: Cire abin da zai ƙone (fuel)
options.b: Toshe oxygen
options.c: Rage zafi ƙasa da ignition point
options.d: Samar da carbon dioxide

hints: Don wuta ta ci gaba da ƙonewa, dole abin da zai ƙone ya kasance a haɗe.
Idan an cire bishiyoyi tun da wuri, wutar ba ta da inda za ta tafi.
chemistry-e6-q5.explanation: Wannan ƙa'idar kashewa ce ta cirewa: ana cire 'abin da zai ƙone', ɗaya daga cikin muhimman abubuwa na ƙonewa, tun da wuri, don haka a hanyar da wutar take yaɗuwa babu fuel da zai ƙone, kuma yaɗuwar wutar daji tana tsayawa.

chemistry-m1-q1.prompt: Menene ainihin dalilin 'matsin gas' da ake ji a bangon akwati rufaffe mai ɗauke da gas?

options.a: Saboda ƙwayoyin gas masu yawa waɗanda suke motsawa kullum da kansu suna yin karo da bangon akwatin
options.b: Saboda ƙwayoyin gas suna nutsewa ƙasa kawai ta ƙarfin jan ƙasa na duniya
options.c: Saboda ƙwayoyin gas suna jan juna ta lantarki
options.d: Saboda ƙwayoyin gas suna ƙoƙarin narkar da bangon akwatin

hints: Ƙwayoyin gas suna tashi da sauri sosai.
Yawan karo da ƙarfinsa a bango suna samar da matsi.
chemistry-m1-q1.explanation: Matsin gas yana bayyana ne ta ƙarfin kowane yanki na bango da ƙwayoyin gas ke yi lokacin da suke motsawa kullum ba tsari suna yin karo da bangon ciki na akwati.

chemistry-m1-q2.prompt: A zafin da bai canza ba, an ƙara matsin gas mai girman 60 mL a 1 atm zuwa 3 atm. Bisa Dokar Boyle, menene girman wannan gas ɗin?

options.a: 20 mL
options.b: 180 mL
options.c: 30 mL
options.d: 120 mL

hints: Dokar Boyle: P₁V₁ = P₂V₂
1 atm × 60 mL = 3 atm × (?) mL
chemistry-m1-q2.explanation: Bisa Dokar Boyle, idan zafi bai canza ba, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.

chemistry-m1-q3.prompt: Lokacin da aka hau tsauni mai tsawo da kunshin kayan ciye-ciye, kunshin ya kumbura sosai kamar zai fashe. Wane ne bayanin dalilin a bisa alaƙar matsi da girman gas?

options.a: Saboda yayin da ake hawa sama, matsin yanayi (matsi na waje) yana raguwa kuma girman gas ɗin cikin kunshin yana faɗaɗa
options.b: Saboda zafin sama a kan tsauni ya yi yawa gas ya faɗaɗa
options.c: Saboda kayan ciye-ciye da ke cikin kunshin sun ƙafe
options.d: Saboda oxygen na sama ya shiga cikin kunshin

hints: Idan tsayi ya ƙaru, iska tana ƙaranci kuma matsin yanayi yana raguwa.
Idan matsi na waje ya ragu, girman gas yana ƙaruwa (Dokar Boyle).
chemistry-m1-q3.explanation: Idan tsayi ya ƙaru, matsin yanayi yana raguwa. Tun da matsin gas na ciki ya fi matsin yanayin waje, girman gas na ciki yana faɗaɗa har sai matsin ciki da na waje sun daidaita.

chemistry-m1-q4.prompt: An saka ƙwallon table tennis da ta lalace a ruwa mai zafi kuma ta sake miƙewa ta zama zagaye da tauri. Wane ne daidai bayanin hakan da Dokar Charles da samfurin ƙwayoyin gas?

options.a: Saboda zafi ya ƙaru kuma motsin ƙwayoyin gas na cikin ƙwallon ya ƙaru, yawan karo da ƙarfinsa ya ƙaru, don haka girma ya faɗaɗa
options.b: Saboda robar ƙwallon ta sha ruwa ta yi kauri
options.c: Saboda ruwa mai zafi ya shiga cikin ƙwallon ya cika ta
options.d: Saboda zafi ya ƙaru kuma adadin ƙwayoyin gas ɗin cikin ƙwallon ya ninka sau 2

hints: Dokar Charles: idan matsi bai canza ba, idan zafi ya ƙaru, girman gas yana faɗaɗa.
Idan zafi ya ƙaru, matsakaicin saurin ƙwayoyin gas yana ƙaruwa.
chemistry-m1-q4.explanation: Bisa Dokar Charles, idan zafi ya tashi, matsakaicin kuzarin motsin ƙwayoyin gas yana ƙaruwa kuma karon da suke yi a bangon ciki yana ƙaruwa; don haka matsin ciki yana ƙaruwa kuma ƙwallon da ta lalace tana miƙewa.

chemistry-m1-c.prompt: [Saurin diffusion mai zurfi] An saka auduga da aka jiƙa da concentrated ammonia water (nauyin ƙwaya 17) da auduga da aka jiƙa da concentrated hydrochloric acid (nauyin ƙwaya 36.5) a ƙarshen biyun dogon bututun gilashi a lokaci guda aka rufe da tsinken roba. Bayan ɗan lokaci, farin hayaƙi (ammonium chloride) ya bayyana a cikin bututun; a ina matsayinsa zai fi kusa?

options.a: Gefen da ya fi kusa da audugar hydrochloric acid
options.b: Gefen da ya fi kusa da audugar ammonia water
options.c: Daidai a tsakiyar bututun gilashi
options.d: A wajen bututun gilashi a cikin iska

hints: Gas mai sauƙin nauyin ƙwaya yana yaɗuwa da sauri (Dokar Diffusion ta Graham).
Ammonia (17) ya fi hydrogen chloride (36.5) sauƙi sosai.
chemistry-m1-c.explanation: Saurin diffusion na gas yana da alaƙa mai juyawa da tushen murabba'in nauyin ƙwaya. Gas ɗin ammonia mai sauƙin nauyin ƙwaya 17 yana tafiya da sauri fiye da gas ɗin hydrogen chloride mai nauyi (36.5), don haka yana yin reaction a wuri mafi kusa da audugar hydrochloric acid wadda take tafiya a hankali, kuma a nan ne farin hayaƙi yake bayyana.

chemistry-m1-q5.prompt: Lokacin da aka saka balan-balan ɗin roba mai tauri da aka hura da iska cikin liquid nitrogen na -196℃, balan-balan ɗin ya yi ɗan ƙarami kusan ya rasa girmansa ya yi lebur. Menene daidai dalili?

options.a: Saboda a zafin da ya yi ƙasa sosai, kuzarin motsin ƙwayoyin gas ɗin balan-balan ɗin ya ragu ƙwarai kuma nisa tsakanin ƙwayoyin ya ragu
options.b: Saboda robar balan-balan ta bar dukkan gas ya ratsa waje
options.c: Saboda dukkan iskar da ke cikin balan-balan ta lalace ta ɓace
options.d: Saboda liquid nitrogen ya soki balan-balan da kaifi

hints: Dokar Charles: girman gas yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da zafi cikakke (absolute temperature).
Idan zafi ya yi ƙasa sosai, motsin ƙwayoyin gas yana raguwa kusan ya tsaya.
chemistry-m1-q5.explanation: Bisa Dokar Charles, idan aka yi saurin sanyaya zuwa $-196^\circ\text{C}$, motsin zafi na ƙwayoyin gas yana raguwa sosai kuma wasu suna zama ruwa, don haka girman ciki yana ƙuntatawa sosai.

chemistry-m2-q1.prompt: Menene ainihin dalilin da atom, wanda ya ƙunshi nucleus da electrons, yake zama neutral a lantarki?

options.a: Saboda cajin (+) na nucleus da jimillar cajin (-) na electrons da ke zagaye nucleus sun yi daidai a girma
options.b: Saboda babu neutrons a cikin nucleus
options.c: Saboda electrons ba su da caji kwata-kwata
options.d: Saboda atom ya yi ƙanƙanta ba zai iya ɗaukar lantarki ba

hints: Nucleus yana da caji (+) saboda protons.
Electrons suna da caji (-).
chemistry-m2-q1.explanation: Atom yana neutral a lantarki saboda jimillar cajin (+) na protons na nucleus a tsakiya da jimillar cajin (-) na electrons da ke zagaye a orbits sun yi daidai daidai a girma.

chemistry-m2-q2.prompt: Wane ne daidai game da samuwar 'ion', inda neutral atom yake rasa ko samun electrons ya ɗauki caji?

options.a: Metal atoms suna rasa electrons cikin sauƙi su zama cations (+), non-metal atoms kuma suna samun electrons su zama anions (-)
options.b: Protons na nucleus suna fita waje su zama anion
options.c: Idan ya rasa electrons, ya zama anion mai caji (-)
options.d: Ko da ya zama ion, jimillar adadin electrons ba ta canzawa

hints: Sodium (Na) yana rasa electron 1 ya zama Na⁺.
Chlorine (Cl) yana samun electron 1 ya zama Cl⁻.
chemistry-m2-q2.explanation: Atom yana rasa electrons na harsashin waje ya zama cation (mafi yawa metals), ko kuma ya sami electrons ya samar da anion (mafi yawa non-metals) wanda ya cika octet rule.

chemistry-m2-q3.prompt: Lokacin da aka saka samfura A da B da ba a sani ba a cikin wutar waje (outer flame), samfur A ya nuna wutar rawaya, samfur B kuma ya nuna wutar kore-shuɗi (blue-green). Wane metal element ne ke cikin samfuran A da B bi da bi?

options.a: Samfur A: sodium (Na) / samfur B: copper (Cu)
options.b: Samfur A: potassium (K) / samfur B: strontium (Sr)
options.c: Samfur A: copper (Cu) / samfur B: lithium (Li)
options.d: Samfur A: barium (Ba) / samfur B: sodium (Na)

hints: Launin wutar sodium na cikin gishiri rawaya ne sosai.
Copper yana nuna launin wuta na kore-shuɗi na musamman.
chemistry-m2-q3.explanation: Kowane metal element yana nuna launi na musamman a flame test. Sodium ($\text{Na}$) yana da wuta rawaya kuma copper ($\text{Cu}$) yana da wuta kore-shuɗi.

chemistry-m2-q4.prompt: Don tabbatar da ko akwai chloride ion (Cl⁻) a cikin ruwan famfo wanda ya rage a matsayin by-product na kashe ƙwayoyin cuta, wane reagent ne za a digo, kuma menene sinadari na farin precipitate da ake samarwa?

options.a: Silver nitrate (AgNO₃) solution — silver chloride (AgCl)
options.b: Sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution — silver hydroxide (AgOH)
options.c: Barium chloride (BaCl₂) solution — barium sulfate (BaSO₄)
options.d: Phenolphthalein solution — silver carbonate (Ag₂CO₃)

hints: Idan silver ion (Ag⁺) da chloride ion (Cl⁻) sun haɗu, ana samar da farin precipitate da ba ya narkewa a ruwa.
Reaction na precipitate: Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ → AgCl↓
chemistry-m2-q4.explanation: Idan silver ion ($\text{Ag}^+$) na silver nitrate solution ya yi reaction da chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) na cikin ruwa, yana samar da farin silver chloride ($\text{AgCl}$) precipitate wanda ba ya narkewa a ruwa, don haka ana iya gano chloride ion.

chemistry-m2-c.prompt: [Binciken ion mai zurfi] Ana son tabbatar da ko akwai lead ion (Pb²⁺) a cikin sharar masana'anta. Idan aka digo potassium iodide (KI) solution, wane ne daidai launin precipitate da sinadarinsa?

options.a: Rawaya precipitate — lead iodide (PbI₂)
options.b: Baƙi precipitate — lead oxide (PbO)
options.c: Fari precipitate — lead chloride (PbCl₂)
options.d: Shuɗi precipitate — lead nitrate (Pb(NO₃)₂)

hints: Idan lead ion da iodide ion sun haɗu, ana samar da precipitate rawaya mai haske.
Pb²⁺ + 2I⁻ → PbI₂↓
chemistry-m2-c.explanation: Idan lead ion ($\text{Pb}^{2+}$) da iodide ion ($\text{I}^-$) suka yi reaction, ana samar da precipitate mai rawaya na musamman da haske, wato lead iodide ($\text{PbI}_2$).

chemistry-m2-q5.prompt: Yayin lantarkin ruwa (electrolysis) da ɗan electrolyte, wane haɗin iskar gas da ke fita a kan sandar (-) da sandar (+) da kuma rabon girmansu daidai ne?

options.a: Sandar (-): hydrogen (H₂),  sandar (+): oxygen (O₂),  rabon girma = 2 : 1
options.b: Sandar (-): oxygen (O₂),  sandar (+): hydrogen (H₂),  rabon girma = 1 : 2
options.c: Sandar (-): hydrogen (H₂),  sandar (+): chlorine (Cl₂),  rabon girma = 1 : 1
options.d: Sandar (-): tururin ruwa,  sandar (+): nitrogen,  rabon girma = 2 : 1

hints: Tsarin sinadarin ruwa shi ne H₂O (atom 2 na hydrogen da atom 1 na oxygen).
Lissafin electrolysis: 2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂
chemistry-m2-q5.explanation: Bisa lissafin electrolysis na ruwa $2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g)$, a kan sandar (-) inda rage-ƙarfi (reduction) ke faruwa ana samun hydrogen $2$ girma, kuma a kan sandar (+) inda oxidation ke faruwa ana samun oxygen $1$ girma.

chemistry-m3-q1.prompt: Mene ne ainihin dalilin da ya sa 'dokar kiyaye taro' ke aiki idan sinadarai suka canza?

options.a: Saboda nau'i da adadin atom ɗin da ke ƙunshe a abu ba sa canzawa kafin da bayan amsawa
options.b: Saboda jimillar adadin molecule koyaushe yana tsayawa daidai
options.c: Saboda sababbin atom suna fitowa da kansu
options.d: Saboda babu zafi da ke fitowa lokacin amsawar sinadarai

hints: Tuna da dokar kiyaye taro ta Lavoisier.
Atom suna sake tsara kansu ne kawai, ba a ƙirƙira ko a ɓata su ba.
chemistry-m3-q1.explanation: Lokacin amsawar sinadarai, yadda atom ke haɗuwa ne kawai ke canzawa su zama sababbin abubuwa, amma nau'i da adadin atom ba sa ƙirƙirowa ko ɓacewa kuma ana kiyaye su yadda suke, don haka jimillar taro ba ta canzawa.

chemistry-m3-q2.prompt: An ƙona foda na copper a cikin crucible a cikin iska domin a samar da copper(II) oxide. Lokacin da 4 g na copper suka amsa gaba ɗaya, an samu 5 g na copper(II) oxide. Nawa ne taron oxygen da ya haɗu, kuma menene rabon taro na copper da oxygen?

options.a: Oxygen 1 g,  copper : oxygen = 4 : 1
options.b: Oxygen 2 g,  copper : oxygen = 2 : 1
options.c: Oxygen 5 g,  copper : oxygen = 4 : 5
options.d: Oxygen 0.5 g,  copper : oxygen = 8 : 1

hints: Dokar kiyaye taro: (copper 4 g) + (oxygen ? g) = copper(II) oxide 5 g
Dokar tsayayyen rabo: rage rabon taro na copper da oxygen.
chemistry-m3-q2.explanation: Taron oxygen da ya amsa shi ne $5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Bisa dokar tsayayyen rabo, rabon taro na copper da oxygen a cikin copper(II) oxide koyaushe shi ne $4 : 1$.

chemistry-m3-q3.prompt: A yanayin zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya, hydrogen da oxygen suna amsawa su samar da tururin ruwa. Menene daidaitaccen 'rabon girma' na hydrogen, oxygen da tururin ruwa da aka samu? (dokar amsawar iskar gas)

options.a: hydrogen : oxygen : tururin ruwa = 2 : 1 : 2
options.b: hydrogen : oxygen : tururin ruwa = 1 : 1 : 1
options.c: hydrogen : oxygen : tururin ruwa = 2 : 1 : 3
options.d: hydrogen : oxygen : tururin ruwa = 1 : 2 : 2

hints: Lissafin sinadarai: 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2H₂O(g)
Bisa dokar Avogadro, rabon lamba na iskar gas = rabon mole = rabon girma.
chemistry-m3-q3.explanation: A cikin lissafin $2\text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2\text{O}(g)$, a yanayin zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya rabon lambobin iskar gas daidai yake da rabon yawan molecule da kuma rabon girma, wato $2 : 1 : 2$.

chemistry-m3-q4.prompt: Wane haɗin ne ya bayyana daidai yadda ƙarfi ke shiga da fita a cikin na'urar dumama hannu da ake girgizawa a lokacin sanyi (oxidation na ƙurar ƙarfe) da kuma jakar sanyaya da ake amfani da ita wajen magance rauni na kwatsam (amsawar ammonium nitrate da ruwa)?

chemistry-m3-c.prompt: [Ƙididdigar lissafi mai zurfi] Idan propane (C₃H₈) ya ƙone gaba ɗaya da oxygen (O₂) yana samar da carbon dioxide (CO₂) da ruwa (H₂O). Menene jimillar ƙididdiga (a + b + c) a cikin daidaitaccen lissafin C₃H₈ + a O₂ → b CO₂ + c H₂O?

chemistry-m3-q5.prompt: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) yana ruɓewa zuwa ruwa da oxygen a hankali sosai a yanayin ɗaki. Lokacin da aka ƙara ɗan foda baƙi na manganese dioxide (MnO₂), kumfa (iskar oxygen) ya fito da sauri. Mene ne aikin manganese dioxide?

chemistry-m3-q5.explanation: Manganese dioxide yana rage ƙarfin kunnawa (activation energy) a ruɓewar hydrogen peroxide ya ƙara saurin amsawa sosai a matsayin catalyst mai ƙarfafawa, yayin da taronsa da tsarinsa na sinadarai ba sa canzawa kafin da bayan amsawa.

chemistry-h1-q1.prompt: Wane sakamakon gwaji ne ya fi daidai wajen kwatanta ikon gudanar da wutar lantarki na abu A (sodium chloride) da abu B (sukari)?

chemistry-h1-q2.prompt: Menene ya faru da yawan ions a cikin maganin da kuma zafin jiki lokacin da ake ƙara maganin ruwa na sodium hydroxide (NaOH) a hankali a cikin wani adadi na dilute hydrochloric acid (HCl)?

chemistry-h1-q2.explanation: A neutralization ana fitar da zafi, don haka zafin maganin yana kan matsayi mafi girma a wurin neutralization inda amsawar ta ƙare. Chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) ion mai kallo ne wanda ba ya amsawa, don haka yawansa yana tsayayye.

chemistry-h1-q3.explanation: Daga mahangar canja wurin electron, ana cewa abin da ya rasa electrons an 'oxidize' shi, kuma abin da ya sami electrons an 'reduce' shi. Adadin electrons da wani abu ya rasa wani abu ne ke samun su, don haka oxidation da reduction koyaushe suna faruwa a lokaci ɗaya.

chemistry-h1-q4.prompt: Mene ne ƙa'idar 'cathodic protection (sacrificial anode)', inda ake haɗa gungu na zinc (Zn) ko magnesium (Mg) a gadojin ƙarfe ko jiragen ruwa na iron (Fe) don hana tsatsa?

chemistry-h1-q4.explanation: Idan aka haɗa iron da zinc ko magnesium waɗanda ke oxidize cikin sauƙi (suna da babban son zama ion), zinc yana rasa electrons ya lalace (oxidize) a madadin iron yana ci gaba da ba iron electrons, don haka ana hana lalacewar iron daga tushe.

chemistry-h1-c.prompt: [Tsarin abu mai zurfi] Wane jeri ne ya nuna daidai adadin electron pairs masu haɗawa da marasa haɗawa na methane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃) da ruwa (H₂O), waɗanda sinadarai ne na nonmetals a period na 2 masu cika ka'idar octet (electrons 8 a bawon waje)?

options.a: CH₄: masu haɗawa 4, marasa haɗawa 0 / NH₃: masu haɗawa 3, marasa haɗawa 1 / H₂O: masu haɗawa 2, marasa haɗawa 2
options.b: CH₄: masu haɗawa 4, marasa haɗawa 4 / NH₃: masu haɗawa 3, marasa haɗawa 2 / H₂O: masu haɗawa 2, marasa haɗawa 0
options.c: CH₄: masu haɗawa 2, marasa haɗawa 2 / NH₃: masu haɗawa 3, marasa haɗawa 0 / H₂O: masu haɗawa 4, marasa haɗawa 1
options.d: Duka molecule uku suna da pair 4 masu haɗawa iri ɗaya

chemistry-h1-c.explanation: Methane ($\text{CH}_4$) yana da pair $4$ masu haɗawa da $0$ marasa haɗawa. Ammonia ($\text{NH}_3$) bisa yanayin nitrogen yana da $3$ masu haɗawa da $1$ mara haɗawa, kuma ruwa ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$) yana da $2$ masu haɗawa da $2$ marasa haɗawa.

chemistry-h1-q5.prompt: Mene ne sunan matsalar muhalli inda sulfur dioxide (SO₂) ko nitrogen oxides (NOx) da ake fitarwa daga ƙona man burbushin halittu ke amsawa da tururin ruwa a sararin samaniya su samar da sulfuric acid ko nitric acid kuma su rage pH na ruwan sama ƙasa da na al'ada (kusan 5.6)?

options.a: Ruwan sama mai acid (Acid Rain)
options.b: Lalacewar ozone layer

chemistry-h1-q5.explanation: Sulfur oxides da nitrogen oxides suna amsawa da ruwa a sararin samaniya su samar da acid masu ƙarfi, sulfuric acid ($\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$) da nitric acid ($\text{HNO}_3$), don haka ruwan sama mai ƙarfin acid mai $\text{pH} < 5.6$ yana sauka yana maida ƙasa da tabkuna acidic.

chemistry-h2-q1.prompt: Nawa ne mole na molecule na methane da kuma jimillar mole na atom na hydrogen (H) a cikin 11.2 L na iskar methane (CH₄, nauyin molecule 16) a 0 ℃ da 1 atm?

options.c: Methane 0.5 mol,  atom na hydrogen 0.5 mol
options.d: Methane 2.0 mol,  atom na hydrogen 8.0 mol

hints: A 0 ℃ da 1 atm, iskar gas 1 mol = 22.4 L.

chemistry-h2-q1.explanation: Adadin mole na methane shi ne $n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Tunda molecule 1 na methane yana ƙunshe da atom $4$ na hydrogen, jimillar mole na atom na hydrogen ita ce $0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.

chemistry-h2-q2.prompt: Nawa ne taron NaOH tsayayye mai tsabta da ake buƙata don shirya 500 mL na maganin ruwa na sodium hydroxide (NaOH, nauyin tsari 40) 0.1 M na ma'auni?
hints: Molarity M = mole (mol) / girman maganin (L)

chemistry-h2-q2.explanation: Adadin mole na $\text{NaOH}$ da ake buƙata shi ne $n = M \times V = 0.1\text{ mol/L} \times 0.5\text{ L} = 0.05\text{ mol}$. Taron da ake buƙata shi ne $w = n \times M_w = 0.05\text{ mol} \times 40\text{ g/mol} = 2.0\text{ g}$.

chemistry-h2-q3.prompt: An ƙara phenolphthalein a cikin 20 mL na maganin ruwa na acetic acid (vinegar) mai ƙarfin da ba a sani ba, kuma aka yi titration da 0.1 M ma'aunin sodium hydroxide (NaOH). Ya koma ja bayan an yi amfani da 40 mL. Menene molarity na maganin acetic acid?
hints: Lissafin neutralization titration: n₁ M₁ V₁ = n₂ M₂ V₂
Acetic acid da sodium hydroxide duka acid ne mai ƙarfin ɗaya da base mai ƙarfin ɗaya (n = 1). M₁ × 20 mL = 0.1 M × 40 mL
chemistry-h2-q3.explanation: Bisa lissafin $n_1 M_1 V_1 = n_2 M_2 V_2$, $1 \times M_1 \times 20\text{ mL} = 1 \times 0.1\text{ M} \times 40\text{ mL}$, don haka $M_1 = 0.2\text{ M}$.

chemistry-h2-c.prompt: [Tsarin molecule na VSEPR mai zurfi] Idan aka kwatanta girman kusurwoyin haɗi bisa ka'idar tunkuɗa pair na electron na bawon valence (VSEPR), tunkuɗawa tsakanin pair marasa haɗawa ya fi tunkuɗawa tsakanin pair masu haɗawa. chemistry-h2-c.explanation: Yayin da adadin pair marasa haɗawa ke ƙaruwa, ana tunkuɗa pair masu haɗawa da ƙarfi kuma kusurwar haɗi tana ƙunƙuntawa. $\text{CH}_4$ ba shi da pair mara haɗawa yana da $109.5^\circ$, $\text{NH}_3$ mai pair 1 yana da $107^\circ$, kuma $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ mai pair 2 yana da $104.5^\circ$.

chemistry-h2-q5.prompt: Menene halayyar gama gari na molecular crystals da ke sublimation cikin sauƙi a yanayin ɗaki, kamar iodine (I₂) ko busasshen ƙanƙara (CO₂)?

options.a: Covalent bonds a cikin molecule suna da ƙarfi, amma 'ƙarfin tsakanin molecule (van der Waals)' da ke riƙe molecule tare yana da rauni sosai
options.b: Haɗin tsakanin atom a cikin molecule ionic bonds ne

chemistry-h2-q5.explanation: A molecular crystals, covalent bonds a cikin molecule suna da ƙarfi, amma jan hankali tsakanin molecule (dispersion forces) yana da rauni sosai kuma ana yanke shi cikin sauƙi da ƙaramin ƙarfin zafi, don haka suna da ƙananan wuraren narkewa da tafasa kuma suna sublimation cikin sauƙi.

chemistry-h3-q1.prompt: Wane bayani ne daidai game da canje-canje idan aka ƙara 'catalyst mai ƙarfafawa' a amsawar sinadarai?

options.b: Yana canza girman reaction enthalpy (ΔH)
options.c: Yana ƙara darajar equilibrium constant (K) yana ƙara yawan samfura
options.d: Yana ƙara yawan masu amsawa kai tsaye

chemistry-h3-q1.explanation: Catalyst mai ƙarfafawa yana ba da sabuwar hanyar amsawa mai ƙarancin ƙarfin kunnawa kuma yana ƙara rate constants na amsawar gaba da ta baya a rabo ɗaya. Ba ya taɓa canza reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) ko equilibrium constant ($K$).

chemistry-h3-q2.prompt: Don amsawa 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), ta hanyar initial rates an gano cewa ninka [NO] sau biyu tare da [O₂] tsayayye ya sa saurin ya zama sau huɗu, kuma ninka [O₂] sau biyu tare da [NO] tsayayye ya sa saurin ya ninka sau biyu. options.c: v = k [NO] [O₂]²,  jimillar amsawar order na 3
options.d: v = k [NO]² [O₂]²,  jimillar amsawar order na 4

hints: v ∝ [NO]^m [O₂]^n

chemistry-h3-q2.explanation: Idan $[\text{NO}]$ ya ninka sau $2$ saurin ya ninka sau $4$, don haka $m=2$, kuma idan $[\text{O}_2]$ ya ninka sau $2$ saurin ya ninka sau $2$, don haka $n=1$. Rate law shi ne $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, kuma jimillar order na amsawa shi ne $2 + 1 = 3$.

chemistry-h3-q3.prompt: Amsawar gas mai fitar da zafi mai zuwa tana cikin dynamic equilibrium a cikin kwantena mai rufi:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + zafi (ΔH < 0).  Waɗanne yanayi ne ya kamata a daidaita don ƙara yawan ammonia (NH₃) a equilibrium?

chemistry-h3-q3.explanation: Tunda amsawar tana fitar da zafi ($\Delta H < 0$), dole ne a rage zafin jiki don amsawar gaba da ke fitar da zafi ta rinjaya. chemistry-h3-q4.prompt: Menene gaskiya game da 'buffer solution' da aka yi ta hanyar haɗa girma iri ɗaya na 0.1 M maganin ruwa na acetic acid (CH₃COOH, dissociation constant Ka = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵) da 0.1 M sodium acetate (CH₃COONa) a 25 ℃?

chemistry-h3-c.prompt: [Colligative properties mai zurfi] Waɗanne daga cikin kalamai masu zuwa game da halayen (colligative properties) na maganin dilute mai ɗauke da solute marar tafiya da non-electrolyte daidai ne? chemistry-h3-q5.prompt: Lissafin ruɓewar sodium azide mai tsayayye (NaN₃), wanda ke kumbura airbag cikin daƙiƙa 0.03 a hatsarin mota, shi ne 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Me ya sa wannan amsawa ta fi dacewa a sinadarai don samar da iskar gas a airbag?

options.d: Saboda ba a samar da iskar gas ba kuma airbag yana kumbura a matsayin soso mai tsayayye

options.a: 60 mL
options.b: 5.0 mL
options.c: 72 mL
options.d: 50 mL

hints: Yi amfani da molarity $M = \frac{10xd}{M_w}$ don gano molarity na maganin 20 % kuma yi amfani da cewa mole na solute daidai yake kafin da bayan ƙara ruwa ($M_1V_1 = M_2V_2$).
chemistry-killer-08.explanation:
Mataki na 1: Molarity na 20 % NaOH $M = \frac{10 \times 20 \times 1.2}{40} = 6.0$ mol/L (a 1 L = 1200 g na magani akwai NaOH 240 g = 6 mol).
Mataki na 2: Mole na solute a cikin maganin da za a shirya = 0.5 mol/L × 0.600 L = 0.30 mol (NaOH 12 g).
Mataki na 3: A ƙara ruwa mole na solute tsayayye ne: 6.0 × V = 0.30 → V = 0.050 L = 50 mL. (Dubawa: 12 g ÷ 0.20 = 60 g na magani, 60 g ÷ 1.2 g/mL = 50 mL)
Amsa: 50 mL (d). (Kuskure: 60 mL ƙima ce da aka lissafa ba tare da yawa ba tare da M = 5.0, 72 mL ƙima ce ta ninka 60 g da yawa, 5.0 mL kuskuren matsayin adadi ne)

chemistry-killer-09.prompt: A amsawar $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$, inda iskar gas A da B ke amsawa a zafi da matsin lamba tsayayye su samar da iskar gas C, A 20 mL da B 60 mL suna amsawa babu ƙari ko rashi kuma ana samun C 40 mL. Sau nawa ne yawan gaurayen iskar gas bayan amsawa ya zama idan aka kwatanta da kafin amsawa?
hints: A zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya, yawan gas yana tafiya daidai da matsakaicin nauyin molecule kuma ana kiyaye taro kafin da bayan amsawa, don haka rabon yawa = juyayyen rabon girma. Nemo girman A da B daga matsakaicin nauyin molecule.

28x + 2(100 − x) = 12.4 × 100 → x = 40 mL (A), B = 60 mL. Rabon girman amsawa A:B:C = 1:3:2 → B 60 mL ya amsa gaba ɗaya, A 20 mL ya ƙare, C 40 mL ya samu, A 20 mL ya rage → jimilla 60 mL bayan amsawa.
chemistry-killer-09.explanation:
Mataki na 1: Rabon girma A:B:C = 20:60:40 = 1:3:2, wato $\mathrm{A + 3B \rightarrow 2C}$.
Mataki na 2: Girman A a cikin 100 mL na gauraye shi ne x: (28x + 2(100 − x))/100 = 12.4 → 26x + 200 = 1240 → x = 40 mL. Don haka A 40 mL, B 60 mL.
Mataki na 3: Idan duk B 60 mL ya amsa, A 20 mL ya ƙare kuma C 40 mL ya samu. Bayan amsawa A 20 mL + C 40 mL = 60 mL.
Mataki na 4: Ana kiyaye taro (tabbatarwa da nauyin molecule: kafin amsawa 40×28 + 60×2 = 1240, bayan amsawa nauyin molecule na C shi ne (28+3×2)/2 = 17, 20×28 + 40×17 = 1240). A zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya yawa = taro/girma, don haka bayan/kafin = 100/60 = 5/3.
Amsa: 5/3 (a). (Kuskure: 3/5 juyayyen ƙima ne, 1 ƙima ce da ke la'akari da kiyaye taro kawai tana watsi da canjin girma, 5/4 ƙima ce da aka lissafa da kuskuren zaton A 40 mL ya rage kuma jimilla 80 mL)

chemistry-killer-10.prompt:

Waɗanne yanayi ne kaɗai ke sa mole (mol) na $\mathrm{NH_3}$ a sabon equilibrium ya fi na equilibrium na asali?
hints: Ka'idar Le Chatelier: equilibrium yana motsawa zuwa hanyar da ke rage canjin. Mole na iskar gas a amsawa suna canzawa daga 4 zuwa 2 (raguwa), kuma amsawar gaba tana fitar da zafi.

(I) ƙara matsin lamba → hanyar rage mole (amsawar gaba). (II) ƙara zafi → hanyar shan zafi (amsawar baya). (III) girma da zafi tsayayye, ƙara Ar → ƙarfin kowane gas ba ya canzawa → babu motsi. chemistry-killer-10.explanation:
Mataki na 1: Mole na iskar gas masu amsawa 4 → samfura 2 mol. Amsawar gaba tana fitar da zafi.
Mataki na 2: (I) Rage girma = ƙara matsin lamba → equilibrium yana komawa amsawar gaba da ke rage mole na gas → NH3 yana ƙaruwa.
(II) Ƙara zafi → hanyar shan zafi, wato amsawar baya → NH3 yana raguwa.
(III) A girma tsayayye, ƙara Ar ba ya canza ƙarfi (matsin kowane gas) na N2, H2 da NH3, don haka Q = K ya tsaya → babu motsi, NH3 ba ya canzawa.
(IV) A matsin lamba tsayayye, ƙara Ar yana ƙara girma kuma duk ƙarfin iskar gas masu amsawa yana raguwa → motsi zuwa amsawar baya da ke ƙara mole na gas → NH3 yana raguwa.
(V) Ƙara $\mathrm{H_2}$ → Q < K → amsawar gaba → ɓangare na H2 ya ƙare kuma NH3 yana ƙaruwa (mole na NH3 yana ƙaruwa).
Mataki na 3: Yanayin da NH3 ke ƙaruwa: (I), (V).
Amsa: (I), (V) (b).

chemistry-killer-11.prompt:
Equilibrium constant na ƙarfi na amsawar $\mathrm{N_2O_4(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NO_2(g)}$ a wani zafi shi ne $K = 0.4$ (an bar naúra). A wannan zafi an sa $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ da $\mathrm{NO_2}$ a cikin kwantena uku masu zuwa kowanne kuma aka bar su su daɗe sosai.

Ta hanyar kwatanta reaction quotient $Q$ da $K$, daidaita daidai hanyar amsawar da ke faruwa a kowace kwantena har sai an kai equilibrium.

options.a: (I) yanayin equilibrium, (II) yanayin equilibrium, (III) amsawar baya
options.b: (I) amsawar gaba, (II) amsawar gaba, (III) yanayin equilibrium
options.c: (I) amsawar gaba, (II) amsawar baya, (III) yanayin equilibrium
options.d: (I) amsawar baya, (II) amsawar gaba, (III) yanayin equilibrium

hints: Sanya molar concentrations (mol/L) a cikin $Q = \frac{[\mathrm{NO_2}]^2}{[\mathrm{N_2O_4}]}$, ba mole ba. Idan Q < K, amsawar gaba tana faruwa, idan Q > K, amsawar baya tana faruwa, kuma idan Q = K, tsarin yana cikin equilibrium.
chemistry-killer-11.explanation:
Mataki na 1: Lissafin ƙarfi. (I) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.4/2.0 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M. (II) 0.5 L: [N2O4] = 0.1/0.5 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4 M. (III) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.1 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M.
Mataki na 2: Lissafin Q. (I) Q = 0.2²/0.2 = 0.2 < 0.4 → amsawar gaba. (II) Q = 0.4²/0.2 = 0.8 > 0.4 → amsawar baya. (III) Q = 0.2²/0.1 = 0.4 = K → yanayin equilibrium.
Amsa: (I) amsawar gaba, (II) amsawar baya, (III) yanayin equilibrium (c). (Kuskure: Idan aka lissafa Q da mole, ana samun (I) 0.4²/0.4 = 0.4 da (II) 0.2²/0.1 = 0.4, don haka a kuskure ana ɗaukar duka biyu equilibrium ne.)

chemistry-killer-12.prompt: A 25 °C, $\mathrm{p}K_a$ na acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) shi ne 4.7. Mataki na 3: Tunda magani ɗaya ne, rabon ƙarfi = rabon mole = 2. pH = 4.7 + log 2 = 4.7 + 0.30 = 5.0.
